answer: One workable design: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because reef only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, river is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any mirror approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
